en.title: Free consultations on preparing proposals, on Fridays
en.summary: The Lithuanian Citizen Science Association invites you to sign up for free consultations on preparing proposals. Consultations take place on Fridays.
en.body:
The Lithuanian Citizen Science Association invites you to sign up for free consultations on preparing proposals. Consultations take place on Fridays.

To sign up, write to us at info@pilieciumokslas.lt.
